 Vs.
Municipal Committee Mymensingh ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 4. Defendants 1 and 2 contested the suit by filing a joint written statement  denying the claim of the plaintiff. Their case was that the suit land was khas land of Maharaja Shashi Kinta Acharyya Chowdhury and appertained to the landlord’s khatian No. 95 of Mymensingh town. Then the Mymensingh Municipality had been entrusted by the Zaminder for protecting the land on behalf of the superior landlord and accordingly, the Municipality was nothing more than the custodian of the land belonging to the proprietor Zamindar. It was leased out to  Saileedra Nath Basu for 9 years and pucca structures were constructed with the knowledge and approval of the Municipality and the superior landlord and the defendants possessed the suit land openly and adversely. They further pleaded that after the acquisition of the rent receiving interests the said land vested in the Government and the defendants had become tenants directly under the Government and the Government had also recognised them.
